# files_event_subscription (Resource)

An EventSubscription selects EventRecords for an EventChannel and sends them to one or more EventTargets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "files_event_subscription" "example_event_subscription" {
  event_channel_id        = 1
  workspace_id            = 1
  apply_to_all_workspaces = true
  name                    = "example"
  subject                 = "example"
  message                 = "example"
  message_only            = true
  enabled                 = true
  event_types             = ["sync_run.failure.v1"]
  filter                  = {
    "payload.sync_name"    = {
      prefix = "Nightly"
    }
    "payload.event_errors" = {
      exists = true
    }
  }
  delivery_policy         = {
    max_attempts        = 3
    retry_delay_minutes = [5, 30]
  }
  event_target_ids        = [1]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Event Subscription name.

### Optional

- `apply_to_all_workspaces` (Boolean) If true, this default-workspace subscription applies to events from all workspaces.
- `delivery_policy` (Dynamic) Event Subscription delivery policy. Overrides retry settings from each Event Target's delivery policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this Event Subscription can dispatch events.
- `event_channel_id` (Number) Event Channel ID
- `event_target_ids` (List of Number) Event Target IDs this subscription sends to.
- `event_types` (List of String) Event type strings matched by this subscription. Blank means all event types. Valid values: `automation_run.canceled.v1`, `automation_run.failure.v1`, `automation_run.failure_will_retry.v1`, `automation_run.partial_failure.v1`, `automation_run.partial_failure_will_retry.v1`, `automation_run.skipped.v1`, `automation_run.success.v1`, `expectation_evaluation.invalid.v1`, `expectation_evaluation.late.v1`, `expectation_evaluation.missing.v1`, `expectation_evaluation.success.v1`, `expectation_incident.acknowledged.v1`, `expectation_incident.open.v1`, `expectation_incident.resolved.v1`, `expectation_incident.snoozed.v1`, `external_event.client_log.failure.v1`, `external_event.client_log.partial_failure.v1`, `external_event.client_log.skipped.v1`, `external_event.client_log.success.v1`, `malware_scan_log.quarantined.v1`, `pending_work_event.failure.v1`, `pending_work_event.partial_failure.v1`, `pending_work_event.skipped.v1`, `pending_work_event.success.v1`, `siem_http_destination_event.failure.v1`, `siem_http_destination_event.partial_failure.v1`, `siem_http_destination_event.skipped.v1`, `siem_http_destination_event.success.v1`, `sso_event.ldap_login.failure.v1`, `sso_event.ldap_login.partial_failure.v1`, `sso_event.ldap_login.skipped.v1`, `sso_event.ldap_login.success.v1`, `sso_event.ldap_sync.failure.v1`, `sso_event.ldap_sync.partial_failure.v1`, `sso_event.ldap_sync.skipped.v1`, `sso_event.ldap_sync.success.v1`, `sso_event.saml_login.failure.v1`, `sso_event.saml_login.partial_failure.v1`, `sso_event.saml_login.skipped.v1`, `sso_event.saml_login.success.v1`, `sync_run.failure.v1`, `sync_run.partial_failure.v1`, `sync_run.skipped.v1`, `sync_run.success.v1`, `user_security_event.lockout.v1`
- `filter` (Dynamic) Conditions on event fields that an event must meet to be delivered, keyed by dot-notation field path. All conditions must match.
- `message` (String) Custom message to include in notification emails.
- `message_only` (Boolean) If true, notification email bodies contain only the custom message, omitting event details and the review button. Requires a custom message, defaults to false, and does not affect non-email targets.
- `subject` (String) Custom subject line to use for notification emails.
- `workspace_id` (Number) Workspace ID. 0 means the default workspace or site-wide.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Event Subscription create date/time.
- `id` (Number) Event Subscription ID
- `updated_at` (String) Event Subscription update date/time.

### JSON property details

Except for `filter`, these properties will move from Dynamic to typed schemas in a major provider release planned for March 1, 2027. Until then, JSON-encoded configuration remains supported with a deprecation warning.

#### filter

Stays Dynamic in every release because its values vary. Native HCL and JSON-encoded strings are both accepted, with no deprecation warning.

Each key is the full dot-notation path to a field in the event JSON that webhook targets receive, such as `payload.status`. Paths can reference top-level fields such as `type`, `workspace_id`, and `occurred_at`, actor fields such as `actor.username`, human-readable fields such as `human.title`, and event-specific fields under `payload`, such as `payload.status`, `payload.sync_name`, or `payload.automation_name`. Fields under `payload` vary by event type. Every segment of a path must name an object key.
Each value is the condition that field must meet: a plain value, an array of values, or an object with exactly one operator key. A plain value works the same as `equals`, and an array works the same as `one_of`.
An event matches only when every condition matches. An empty object matches every event of the subscription's event types.

- `[key]` (string or number or boolean or list of values or object, optional)

#### delivery_policy

Retry settings for deliveries from this subscription. Each omitted key uses the value from the Event Target's delivery_policy, and then the default.

- `max_attempts` (integer, optional) Maximum delivery attempts, including the first attempt. A value below 1 uses the default of 5. Null works like an omitted key.
- `retry_delay_minutes` (list of integers, optional) Minutes to wait before each retry. The last value is used for any later retries, so a list with one value applies it to every retry. An empty list uses the default of [1,5,15,60,180]. Null works like an omitted key.

#### Migrating JSON-encoded configuration

Replace `jsonencode(...)` with native HCL as in the examples below.

```hcl
# Legacy JSON encoding
delivery_policy = jsonencode({
  max_attempts        = 3
  retry_delay_minutes = [5, 30]
})

# Native HCL, same keys and nesting
delivery_policy = {
  max_attempts        = 3
  retry_delay_minutes = [5, 30]
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Event Subscriptions can be imported by specifying the id.
terraform import files_event_subscription.example_event_subscription 1
```
